name: sfx_slave
description: ScaleFX generic slave protocol — server template + master-side client.  SlaveServer<TServos, TPwms, TLeds, TBattery> (server side) dispatches the 0x01..0x7F SlavePacket range, owns the IDLE/SLAVE/DIRECT lifecycle, the keepalive-watchdog → safe-state path, the async-event emitters (SERVO_TARGET_REACHED, SERVO_MOTION_UPDATE, LED_PROGRAM_DONE, PWM_STALL, BATTERY_ALERT), the unified status broadcast, and the BoardIdentifier persistence.  SlaveClient (master side, sfx_slave/client/) provides the typed CommandResult API + observer chain consumed by HubFX effect orchestrators.
